notes: A provisional fan network, not a confirmed transport plan for the game. All route orders remain single-source.
Direct transfers require the same GTAMap marker identity. Additional walking transfers are included only when enabled, as unverified proximity suggestions.
Unmarked shelters retain source occurrence labels and separate identities. Their position and usable interchange are unresolved.
Consecutive duplicate markers on MM and AM are collapsed into one station. This does not establish separate platforms or boarding rules.
Freight Rail is excluded because the source lists no usable passenger sequence. N02 is a city bus route; no night service is claimed.
Queen Palm Ave is listed under Southwind by GTAMap and under Watson Bay by GTABase. That match remains unresolved.
Planning compares stop segments and transfers. Derived straight-line distances are shown for walking transfers; travel times and live arrivals are not provided.
Optional walking transfers use up to three nearby boarding stops within the selected straight-line radius. Paths, crossings, barriers and access have not been verified; this option is off by default.

All 25 passenger directions are explicitly loops in the public transit file; its route geometries also close. Added closing edges follow that declaration, not proximity. Repeated visits remain ordered calls, not free branches.
